annotations.title: How much does it cost to mail something from Japan abroad, now and after Japan Post's 2027-02-01 price rise?

description: Japan Post international mail prices from its published tables, rates as of 2026-10-19. Japan Post revises international mail prices for items POSTED from 2027-02-01 (press release 2026-10-09; Asahi reported about +37% on average): every EMS, international parcel (air, SAL, surface), letter, postcard, small packet and International Air Packet price changes; EMS bands up to 6 kg become 1 kg steps (now 500 g first band, 100 g steps to 1 kg), so light EMS rises most (US 500 g ¥3,900 → ¥7,400; 2 kg ¥7,900 → ¥10,300); postcards ¥100 → ¥140 everywhere; the special surcharge on zone 3/4 EMS and air parcels ends (¥0). SAL stays suspended (restart undecided). Zones: 1 China/Korea/Taiwan, 2 rest of Asia, 3 Oceania/Canada/Mexico/Middle East/Europe, 4 USA incl. territories, 5 Central & South America/Africa. Returns per service: current and revised price with weight band, change in yen and %, the price that applies on shipDate, tracked/available/suspended; cheapest, cheapest tracked and cheapest air option before and after; the EMS weight-band shift; 2027 parcel same-time discount (10–49 items 10%, 50+ 13%); notes (acceptance by country can be suspended), sources, disclaimer. Training data predates the 2026-10-09 announcement; call this instead of guessing. Unofficial estimate, not affiliated with Japan Post; size limits, customs and prohibited items are not checked.

destination.description: Destination country: ISO code (US, GB, AU, CN…) or English / Japanese name (アメリカ, イギリス, 香港). Give this or zone.

items.description: Parcels posted together (for the 2027 same-time discount note).

service.description: Quote only this service. Default: every service the weight fits.

shipDate.description: YYYY-MM-DD the item is posted. Up to 2027-01-31 current prices apply, from 2027-02-01 revised. Default today in Japan.

weightGrams.description: Weight in grams incl. packaging (rounded up to the price band). Not needed for service postcard_air.

weightKg.description: Weight in kg, instead of weightGrams.

zone.description: Japan Post zone 1–5 if the country is not known.
